blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — EJ Obiena showed once again why he’s Asia’s best, soaring to his second straight Asian Games gold and setting a new record at 5.91 meters on a rainy Tuesday at Nagoya City Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium Obiena missed his first two attempts at 5.80m, but he was able to clinch the gold after his last competitor Li Chen-Yang of China missed his attempts at the same height.
